title: Resolvent norm bound for adaptive Langevin dynamics with Nose-Hoover thermostatted friction, uniform in the friction and time-scale separation
author: Étienne Bernard; Max Fathi; Antoine Levitt; Gabriel Stoltz
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 5 (2022), pp. 523-557, publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.129
difficulty_reason: 1017-1031对Nosé-Hoover扩张的块算子计算宏观coercivity，以Poincare张量化给出min(2d/epsilon^2,Knu^2)并证明耦合块消失，再套精确H2界。参数epsilon的不同块结构有实际内容，不只替换摩擦系数。

primary.label: author proposition environment (unlabelled); statement at source lines 1010-1015, printed as Proposition 3.12 in the journal: under Assumption ass:Poincare_nu there exists C in R_+ such that for all gamma, eps > 0 the resolvent of the adaptive Langevin generator satisfies ||cL^{-1}|| <= C max(gamma eps^2, gamma, 1/gamma, 1/(gamma eps^2))

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof: Assumptions ass:structural_Pi, ass:A_inv and ass:reversibility hold as for the Langevin dynamics; a simple computation gives the numbered-free display cLa_subplus0^* cLa_subplus0 = ((2d/(beta^2 eps^2)) partial_xi^* partial_xi + (1/beta) nabla_q^* nabla_q) Pi_0, whence by tensorization of Poincare inequalities Assumption ass:macro_coercivity holds with a^2 = (1/beta) min(2d/eps^2, K_nu^2); for Assumption ass:technical_ass, computations as in the proof of Corollary cor:Lang (pointer) show Pi_1 cLFD Pi_1 bounded and cLs_21 cLa_12 Pi_0 (B^*B)^{-1} = 0 since cLs_21 = gamma Pi_2 cLFD Pi_1 = 0 for the quadratic kinetic energy choice eq:quadratic_U; from the computations in the proof of LSS19 Lemma 2.7 there exists R in R_+ with ||Pi_subplus cLham^2 Pi_0 (cLa_subplus0^* cLa_subplus0)^{-1}|| <= R max(1, 1/eps); an application of Theorem thm:bounds_Linv concludes (source lines 1017-1031)

contexts.label: the Adaptive Langevin dynamics setup preceding the counted proposition: the numbered quadratic kinetic energy choice eq:quadratic_U (U(p) = |p|^2/2, journal (3.20)), the normalized invariant measure mu(dq dp dxi) = Z^{-1} exp(-beta(|p|^2/2 + V(q) + xi^2/2)) dq dp dxi (see LSS19), the generator cL = cLham + gamma cLFD + (1/eps) cLNH with cLham and cLFD as in the Langevin setting (journal (3.2)-(3.3)) and the Nose-Hoover thermostating operator cLNH = (|p|^2 - d/beta) partial_xi - xi p^T nabla_p, and the observation that cLs = gamma cLFD while cLa = cLham + eps^{-1} cLNH, so that the Section 2 framework retrieves the LSS19 resolvent scaling (source lines 993-1009)
